17: /** Strict JSON snapshot. No property reads, hooks, coercion or Unicode normalization. */
18: export function canonicalizeCompleteJson(
19:   value: unknown,
20:   limits: CompleteJsonLimits = {}
21: ): string {
22:   const maxBytes = limits.maxBytes ?? 32768
23:   const maxDepth = limits.maxDepth ?? 32
24:   const maxNodes = limits.maxNodes ?? 10000
25:   for (const limit of [maxBytes, maxDepth, maxNodes]) {
26:     if (!Number.isSafeInteger(limit) || limit < 0)
27:       throw new CompleteJsonError('RESULT_COMPLEXITY', 'Invalid JSON limit')
28:   }
29:   const chunks: string[] = []
30:   let bytes = 0,
31:     nodes = 0
32:   const ancestors = new Set<object>()
33:   const invalid = (): never => {
34:     throw new CompleteJsonError('INVALID_JSON', 'Value is not strict JSON')
35:   }
36:   const complexity = (): never => {
37:     throw new CompleteJsonError(
38:       'RESULT_COMPLEXITY',
39:       'JSON complexity limit exceeded'
40:     )
41:   }
42:   const append = (part: string): void => {
43:     bytes += Buffer.byteLength(part, 'utf8')
44:     if (bytes > maxBytes)
45:       throw new CompleteJsonError(
46:         'RESULT_TOO_LARGE',
47:         'JSON byte limit exceeded'
48:       )
